name: SkyTube Legacy
tagline: An ad-free and open-source YouTube client for legacy devices.
blurb: SkyTube is a YouTube player that allows you to: • play YouTube videos • download videos • browse YouTube channels • search videos, music and channels • watch channels' playlists •
description:
SkyTube is a YouTube player that allows you to:

• play YouTube videos

• download videos

• browse YouTube channels

• search videos, music and channels

• watch channels' playlists

• view video comments

• video swipe controls (volume, brightness, comments and description)

• bookmark videos

• import subscriptions from YouTube

• channel subscription with non-intrusive notifications

• subscriptions feed

• view and download video thumbnails

• explore Trending and Most Popular videos

In addition, SkyTube is equipped with a robust blocking attribute that allows you to avoid unwanted videos, with capabilities such as channel blacklisting/whitelisting, filtering, exclusions for low views and high dislikes, etc.

All of this at the tips of your fingers!

More features will be added in the near future.
